name: LinkedIn Jobs and Recruiter
summary: LinkedIn's job posting and recruiting tools.

flows.title: Send an InMail message to a member
steps: Go to the profile of the member you want to write to. You can also search for a member and send a new InMail message from the messaging page or conversation windows.
Click the More button in their introduction section.
Select Message, followed by the member's name, from the drop-down.
In the New message window, type a subject if you want one; the field is optional.
Type the message in the text box.
